Most private practices track revenue.

Very few track these 3 numbers 👇

1️⃣ Cost per new patient
2️⃣ No-show rate
3️⃣ How many new patients come back within 90 days

Every empty slot is money you already spent to fill it. And a schedule full of one-time visits never pays you back.

Score yourself honestly. 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Want the sheet that calculates all 3 from last month's numbers?
